import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import triton
import triton.language as tl
@triton.jit
def custom_kernel(
    x_ptr, w_ptr, b_ptr, y_ptr,
    N, C: tl.constexpr, H, W, CO, HO, WO,
    x_sN, x_sC, x_sH, x_sW,
    w_sCO, w_sC, w_sKH, w_sKW,
    y_sN, y_sC, y_sH, y_sW,
    STRIDE_H: tl.constexpr, STRIDE_W: tl.constexpr,
    PAD_H: tl.constexpr, PAD_W: tl.constexpr,
    KH: tl.constexpr, KW: tl.constexpr,
      BLOCK_P: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_CO: tl.constexpr, K_TILE: tl.constexpr, K: tl.constexpr,
  ):
    pid0 = tl.program_id(0)
    pid1 = tl.program_id(1)
    # Decompose pid1 into (co_block, wo_block)
    wo_blocks = (WO + BLOCK_P - 1) // BLOCK_P
    co_block = pid1 // wo_blocks
    wo_block = pid1 % wo_blocks
    # Tile indices
    offs_co = co_block * BLOCK_CO + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_CO)
    offs_wo = wo_block * BLOCK_P + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_P)
    # Bounds/masks
    mask_co = offs_co < CO
    mask_wo = offs_wo < WO
    # Compute (n, ho) for this row program id and wo vector for columns
    n = pid0 // HO
    ho = pid0 % HO
    # Base input coordinates before kernel offsets (with stride and padding)
    hin_base = ho * STRIDE_H - PAD_H
    win_base = offs_wo * STRIDE_W - PAD_W  # [BLOCK_P], int32
    # Prepare output base offsets
    base_y_row = n * y_sN + ho * y_sH
    y_base = base_y_row + offs_wo * y_sW  # [BLOCK_P]
    y_co = offs_co * y_sC  # [BLOCK_CO]
    # Accumulator
    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_CO, BLOCK_P), dtype=tl.float32)
    # Precompute base for x
    base_x_n = n * x_sN
    # Reduction over C * KH * KW
    # Reduction over K = C*KH*KW using K_TILE and tl.dot
    # K is passed as a tl.constexpr parameter
    for k0 in tl.static_range(0, K, K_TILE):
        k_ids = k0 + tl.arange(0, K_TILE)
        k_mask = k_ids < K
        c_idx = k_ids // (KH * KW)
        rem = k_ids % (KH * KW)
        kh_idx = rem // KW
        kw_idx = rem % KW
        ihs = hin_base + kh_idx  # [K_TILE]
        iws = offs_wo[None, :] * STRIDE_W - PAD_W + kw_idx[:, None]  # [K_TILE, BLOCK_P]
        valid_h = (ihs >= 0) & (ihs < H)
        valid_w = (iws >= 0) & (iws < W)
        x_offsets = (base_x_n
                     + c_idx[:, None] * x_sC
                     + ihs[:, None] * x_sH
                     + iws * x_sW)
        w_offsets = (offs_co[:, None] * w_sCO
                     + c_idx[None, :] * w_sC
                     + kh_idx[None, :] * w_sKH
                     + kw_idx[None, :] * w_sKW)
        x_mask = valid_h[:, None] & valid_w & mask_wo[None, :] & k_mask[:, None]
        w_mask = mask_co[:, None] & k_mask[None, :]
        x_tile = tl.load(x_ptr + x_offsets.to(tl.int64), mask=x_mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
        w_tile = tl.load(w_ptr + w_offsets.to(tl.int64), mask=w_mask, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
        acc += tl.dot(w_tile, x_tile)
    b_vals = tl.load(b_ptr + offs_co.to(tl.int64), mask=mask_co, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
    acc += b_vals[:, None]
    # Store results
    y_offsets = y_co[:, None] + y_base[None, :]
    out_mask = mask_co[:, None] & mask_wo[None, :]
    tl.store(y_ptr + y_offsets.to(tl.int64), acc, mask=out_mask)
